{{Otheruses|maze}}
A [[hedge maze]] was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] hedge of ceremonial trees that lined the front entrance to the [[Well of the World Brain]]. The trees were as resilient as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], fireproof, and contained toxin filled needles ranging in size from a [[Human/Legends|Human]] thumb to a forearm. The hedge was decorated by colored epiphytes and flowers by the different castes of the Yuuzhan Vong. Both a ceremonial and defensive avenue leading towards the [[World Brain]], as it grew, it formed a twenty by thirty meter tunnel that was resilient to even a detonation from within.

At the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the hedge maze was removed, destroyed by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces.
